---
name: Orval and Zod integer compatibility
description: The current workspace generator emits zod.int() for OpenAPI integer fields while the installed Zod runtime is v3.
---

For API contracts in this workspace, represent numeric whole-number fields as OpenAPI `number` when generated validation must compile, then enforce whole-number semantics at the server boundary before persisting.

**Why:** The installed Zod package does not expose the top-level `int()` helper generated by the current Orval template, so OpenAPI `integer` fields make the shared library typecheck fail.

**How to apply:** When the generator/runtime versions are unchanged, use `number` plus range constraints in OpenAPI and add `Number.isInteger` checks in route handlers that store integer values.
